end.summary:
Practised neutralisation in daily life using antacids as an example.
Identified that an acid and base cancel each other’s effects.
Recalled salt and water as products; discussed heat and fizzing with lemon and baking soda.
Named carbon dioxide as the gas causing fizzing.
Teach-back was not passed; the child requested to stop.
end.parentNote: Khushi practised how antacids reduce excess stomach acid and how acids and bases react to form salt and water, with heat released. They connected lemon and baking soda to fizzing and identified carbon dioxide. A mix-up about whether acid-base mixing makes poison was raised but was not clearly corrected before the lesson ended. At home, ask Khushi to explain one neutralisation example using the pattern “acid + base → salt + water.”
